partners.mechanism_chain: TECR (HGNC:11463) —DISRUPTS→ Fatty acid elongation (REACT:R-HSA-70103); Fatty acid elongation (REACT:R-HSA-70103) —LEADS_TO→ Hypomyelination (HP:0011197); Fatty acid elongation (REACT:R-HSA-70103) —LEADS_TO→ Keratoderma (HP:0000970); ELOVL1 (HGNC:29718) —DISRUPTS→ Sterol biosynthesis (REACT:R-HSA-5688204); Sterol biosynthesis (REACT:R-HSA-5688204) —LEADS_TO→ Keratoderma (HP:0000970); Sterol biosynthesis (REACT:R-HSA-5688204) —LEADS_TO→ Spasticity (HP:0001257); Sterol biosynthesis (REACT:R-HSA-5688204) —LEADS_TO→ Dysmorphic facial features (HP:0001999).
